summary: Backend-only unit test verification for the duplicate signal fix in SessionManager. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_bot_units.py with 3 new pytest cases covering the remaining fix behaviors (task lifecycle guards + mid-flow active check). Ran the full pytest suite: 32/32 tests pass (24 in test_bot_units.py + 8 in test_login_extraction.py).
critical_code_review_comments: sessions.py:128 close() is a sync method that calls task.cancel() but never awaits the cancellation. It works but leaves cancellation as fire-and-forget. Consider making it async and awaiting _cancel_task for stronger guarantees (currently start() does await old-task cancellation, which is what matters most for the dedup fix).

sessions.py:263 _run_signal adds the dedup key BEFORE the first send_photo call. If the first send_photo raises, the (code, entry_ts) is still marked as sent, so the retry-on-next-loop path would not re-send. This is intentional for dedup safety but worth noting in code comments.
sessions.py: no explicit locking around _sent_entries; only safe because _loop is single-tasked. The extra start()-time cancellation of previous tasks is the actual guarantee. Good.
test_credentials: None required (fully mocked Quotex/Telegram via FakeBot/FakeQxForRun).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bot is standalone python (no supervisor / no HTTP API). Run tests with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. All 32 tests pass. Duplicate-signal fix is fully covered by TestDuplicateGuard (3 tests) and TestSessionLifecycle (2 tests) inside test_bot_units.py. The ignore supervisor uvicorn misconfiguration on this container is expected — server.py does not exist.
rca of the issue: Original duplicate signal bug RCA: (1) previous SessionManager.close() only cancelled refresh_task, leaving the _loop task running so it kept sending signals to the new session's channel after a Start->Stop->Start cycle; (2) no dedup set, so if _pick_best happened to select the same market twice in the same minute (or an overlapping task from a prior session did), a second signal+result pair would be sent. Fix verified by: TestSessionLifecycle.test_close_cancels_both_task_and_refresh_task (close cancels self.task too), TestSessionLifecycle.test_start_cancels_previous_running_tasks (start awaits _cancel_task for old task/refresh_task), TestDuplicateGuard.test_run_signal_dedup_skips_second_send_for_same_entry (second _run_signal call with same market+entry_ts is a no-op, no extra photos), TestDuplicateGuard.test_pick_best_skips_already_signaled_markets (_pick_best returns None when the only candidate is in _sent_entries for next entry_ts), TestDuplicateGuard.test_run_signal_aborts_when_session_closed_mid_flow (intermediate self.active check aborts result photo when session closed after signal photo).
